content: शब(व)रः .²1 A mountaineer, barbarian, savage; राजन् गुञ्जाफलानां स्रज इति शबरा नैव हारं हरन्ति <ls>K.</ls> P 10. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of Śiva. .²3 The hand. .²4 Water. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a celebrated commentator and writer on Mīmāṃsā. .{@-री@} .²1 A Śabara female. .²2 A female {%Kirāta%} who was an ardent devotee of Rāma.
